name: oletools
label: OLETools
description: OLEtools is a suite of Python tools used for analyzing Microsoft OLE2 files (also known as Structured Storage, Compound File Binary Format, or Microsoft Office documents such as .doc, .xls, .ppt, and .msg). It is particularly popular in digital forensics, malware analysis, and incident response for examining potentially malicious Office documents.

operations.title: Oleid
operations.description: Scans OLE files for indicators of potential malicious activity (e.g., macros, encryption).

parameters.title: File IRI
parameters.description: Specify the file IRI to activate the oletools analysis on.
parameters.name: file_iri
parameters.tooltip: Specify the file IRI to activate the oletools analysis on.

parameters.title: File Password
parameters.description: If encrypted office files are encountered, try decryption with this password. (if specified dont specify the non_secret_password parameter).
parameters.name: file_password
parameters.tooltip: If encrypted office files are encountered, try decryption with this password. (if specified dont specify the non_secret_password parameter).
